description: This is a PHP test class for ReportingMethodConfigurationDao, part of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, testing CRUD operations and utility methods for reporting methods.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ReportingMethodConfigurationDao class methods which manage reporting methods in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture, including instantiation of the DAO and populating test data.

methods.name: testAddReportingMethod
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a new ReportingMethod entity.

methods.name: testEditReportingMethod
methods.description: Tests editing an existing ReportingMethod entity.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a ReportingMethod by ID.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of ReportingMethod entities with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodListWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies limiting the number of retrieved ReportingMethod entities.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Checks the count of ReportingMethod entities matching filter criteria.

methods.name: testDeleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple ReportingMethod entities.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion with a non-existent record ID, expecting no deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Verifies case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant checking of existing reporting method names.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Checks retrieval of ReportingMethod entities by name with different casing and whitespace variations.
